observations.behavior: Replaces a generic Error with a specific SkillBundleFileLimitError when the file count exceeds SKILL_BUNDLE_MAX_FILES.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream callers to distinguish a file-limit violation from other errors, supporting clearer recovery or user messaging.

observations.behavior: Wraps collectSkillFiles in a try-catch and re-throws a user-friendly message if the file limit is exceeded.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the caller to distinguish a file-limit error and present a tailored message, rather than a generic error, improving user experience.
